findings.problem: Line 4 says 'this invitation doesn't stay small' and 'The guest list just went WORLDWIDE', and line 7 sums it up as 'the call reaches all the way to the nations'. That presents the nations as guests invited to the LORD's free feast. Isaiah 55:4-5 doesn't say that. It says the LORD made David a witness to the nations, that the people being invited will summon a nation they do not know, and that nations who do not know them will run to them because the LORD has bestowed glory on them. The text never links the nations to the invitation of Isaiah 55:1-3, so the Big Idea fills in how the two connect. The joke can stay if the fact line says only what the verses say, for example that nations will come running to the people He's inviting.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
